title: Open exact implementation evidence and know when it changed
statement: As a reviewer, I can open the exact source behind an explanation and see when it no longer matches, so that I can trust the implementation context I am reading.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Deleted code opens from the version where it still existed.
A code link follows a file that was renamed without changing.
A binary change is linked at whole-file scope.
A code link follows its referenced lines when they move without changing.
A code link is marked stale when its referenced content changes.
A stale code link lets the reader inspect what changed since it was captured.
After a merge, code links continue to open the landed source when the branch is deleted.
Changing only the Saga does not mark unchanged code links stale.
